app.title: PDF Redaction Tool
app.subtitle: Robust redaction (real removal) with post-export audit
rules.options.label: Options
modal.edit.title: Edit item
form.nothingToDo.rules: Please add at least one item to redact and/or select a preset.
form.hint: The source file is never modified. Export is blocked if the audit detects a leak.
viewer.title: PDF preview
viewer.placeholder.title: PDF preview (coming soon)
viewer.placeholder.body: This area is reserved for the PDF viewer and upcoming visual redaction interactions.
viewer.error.load: Unable to load the PDF in the viewer.
result.success.title: Success
result.error.title: Failed: audit error
result.inconclusive.title: Export refused: an area could not be read
result.inconclusive.help: Nothing suggests a targeted value survived. The engine reports the opposite: an image or a font is unreadable to it, so it can state nothing about that area. In Block mode, only a rectangle fully covering the area lifts the refusal. Switch to Review to look at it and confirm yourself.
rules.selection.none: Select text in the PDF to prepare targeted redaction.
viewer.drop.title: Drop a PDF here
viewer.drop.body: Or click to choose a PDF file
rules.page.title: Page
rules.rectangle.title: Rectangle
form.imageMode.none.help: Images are never modified, even when a redaction rectangle overlaps them.
form.imageMode.remove.help: Any image touched by a redaction rectangle is removed entirely.
form.imageMode.pixels.help: Only the area intersected by the redaction is blackened. The rest of the image stays visible (possibly with lossy re-encoding).
form.imageRegions.review.help: An image or font the text rules could not read is shown to you before export. You confirm each area.
form.imageRegions.block.help: Export is refused until an unreadable area is covered by a rectangle. No confirmation unlocks it.
form.imageRegions.ignore.help: Export proceeds without looking at these areas. Data written inside an image will survive with no message at all.
result.diagnostic.lineBreakSplit: The targeted text is split across two lines or two cells that the engine deliberately refuses to merge -- that refusal is what stops it from redacting two unrelated columns by mistake. It could not target the text, so the text is still in the document.
result.diagnostic.lineBreakSplit.action: Draw a rectangle over each part listed below, then submit again.
review.title: Check before exporting
review.intro: These cannot be checked automatically. Look at each one, then confirm.
review.item.opaque.hint: The text rules could not read this region. If it holds something to remove, draw a rectangle over it.
review.item.font.hint: On this page the text is encoded in a way the rules cannot read. What you see on screen is invisible to them.
review.covered: area(s) already covered by a rectangle, in green.
